request: Order ORD-1001 hasn't shipped yet. Investigate why and what we should do.

steps.text: I will pull the order details to confirm its status, fulfillment warehouse, items, and the promised delivery date.
I will check current available stock for each line item at WH-BOS to see if a stock shortage explains why it hasn't shipped.
I will search other warehouses for 38 units of SKU-202 to see if a single site can cover the shortfall for a stock transfer.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1001 has not shipped because the fulfillment warehouse (WH-BOS) does not have enough stock of SKU-202 to fulfill the ordered quantity. A transfer from WH-CHI can cover the shortfall before fulfillment.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1001 fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT at WH-BOS, ship_by_date 2026-03-17, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-19 (investigation_date 2026-03-16)
check_inventory: SKU-202 at WH-BOS on_hand 12, reserved 0, available 12 (ordered 50)
find_alternative_stock: SKU-202 required_quantity 38; WH-CHI available 80 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-ATL available 30 false; WH-DAL available 0 false
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient inventory at WH-BOS (12 available vs 50 ordered) preventing shipment.
uncertainties: Whether a stock transfer from WH-CHI to WH-BOS can arrive in time to meet the 2026-03-19 promised delivery date (no transfer lead time available).
Whether the customer will approve a split shipment (12 now, 38 later).
Whether there is any inbound replenishment to WH-BOS arriving before the ship-by date (not available in current data).

recommended_actions.details: Initiate an immediate transfer of 38 units of SKU-202 from WH-CHI to WH-BOS to cover the shortfall; justified by find_alternative_stock showing WH-CHI available 80 and can_cover_required_quantity true for 38 units.
Ship the 12 available units of SKU-202 from WH-BOS now to reduce customer impact; justified by check_inventory showing available 12 against ordered 50.

Inform Northwind Retail of a split shipment and potential delivery risk given the ship_by_date 2026-03-17 and promised_delivery_date 2026-03-19; reference check_inventory shortage and the planned transfer from WH-CHI.

arguments.recommendation: Transfer 38 units of SKU-202 from WH-CHI and ship the 12 available units from WH-BOS now; notify the customer about the split shipment and potential delivery timing.
missing_information: Estimated transfer lead time from WH-CHI to WH-BOS
Any scheduled inbound replenishment for SKU-202 at WH-BOS
